tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search active rooms and flats for long-term stays in Warsaw or Kraków by district, move-in and move-out dates, place type, rooms and maximum monthly rent. Each result links to its Subletka page, where the person can contact the lister.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full details of one listing, including its description, all photos and terms.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Cities with active listing counts, lowest and median monthly rent, and every district name accepted by search_listings with its count and median monthly rent.
